text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, Mihono Bourbon called out to me.
She seemed to still be fretting over that costume party—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I intended to create a cyborg costume,
but time is insufficient.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: At this rate, I fear I will not make it in time for the party...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Another, you say?
...Indeed. Considering the remaining time, that is determined to be the prudent choice.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Production within limited timeframe"
"Costume requiring no facial expression change"
"Within my acting capacity"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Initiating search based on the above criteria.
—Mission, start.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
An animal that doesn't change facial expressions... you say?
Let's see, how about something like a shoebill stork?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Of course, they have their own ways of expressing emotion, but the encyclopedia mentioned they rarely move and their expressions are hard to read.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right! For example, a talking shoebill that appears in a certain fantasy novel—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. I-I'm sorry.
I almost started rambling on and on...
Ugh, that bad habit of mine.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No problem.
Shoebill stork... preparing input.
Could you inform me of the encyclopedia's location?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Loading shoebill stork from memory.
"World's Mysterious Animal Encyclopedia" page 36, Figure 1: Shoebill Stork—initiating.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Replication complete.
How is this?
Requesting candid feedback.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, its expressions might not change, but Mihono Bourbon isn't completely motionless...
I replied.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Determined valid point.
Ceasing all movement at the party venue is predicted to further deteriorate the atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Costume "Shoebill Stork" eliminated from candidates.
Initiating new search for target costume.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Haaah. Stop thinking 'bout such troublesome stuff and just enjoy yerself.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Besides, ya won't find nothin' searchin' around a place like this.
...Wait, actually there is somethin'. Right over there.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, a carrot, like the shoebill...
No, even more so, does not move.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Then just be the leafy greens part on top.
Swayin' in the wind oughta do it, right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood, then...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Hey.
Am I supposed to play the straight man to this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For a while after that, we continued looking for suitable costume ideas, but—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Search within the academy complete.
Result—discovery of target costume is difficult.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Previously, Creek-san told me
"You are fine just as you are."
Even if I wear a costume, being myself is fine.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The moment I attempt to imitate something,
I determine that it is no longer "as I am."
choice_data_list: Without overthinking, isn't there something you want to be?
Without overthinking, isn't there anything you want to be?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Something I want to be...
...A fighter jet soaring through space... perhaps.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, costume fabrication for that would be even more difficult than a cyborg.
If there is anything else...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...A fast and strong horse girl.
That is all that comes to mind right now...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Am I truly a "boring horse girl" after all?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I shall ponder this further.
...I must complete the assigned mission no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if reprimanding herself, Mihono Bourbon lifted her head and walked off.
It seemed she had not given up just yet.
